name: ThermOmegaTech Electronics Division
old_description: ThermOmegaTech’s Electronics division specializes in custom PCB assembly for aerospace, defense, and commercial electronics markets.
about:
ThermOmegaTech Electronics Division operates from Warminster, Pennsylvania, as a specialized unit of ThermOmegaTech focused on custom printed circuit board assembly for aerospace, defense, and commercial electronics markets. The division leverages the parent company’s three decades of experience in electronic manufacturing, though a specific founding year for the electronics division is not publicly stated.

The facility provides a full suite of electronic contract manufacturing services, including surface-mount and through-hole PCB assembly, rigid and flexible circuit fabrication, multi-layer board production, electro-mechanical assembly, box builds, and cable assembly. It also offers new product introduction (NPI) support, design-for-manufacturability (DFM) consulting, PCB prototyping, and turnkey assembly solutions. A dedicated brand, TemitroniK, produces LED boards up to 2 feet by 5 feet with IoT control integration. Engineering services cover analog, digital, RF, and multilayer PCB design. The Warminster plant is equipped with automated SMART assembly lines capable of short-run to high-volume production.

Customers span aerospace and defense, medical devices, industrial equipment, LED lighting, non-commodity consumer electronics, and telecommunications sectors. The division serves both commercial and defense programs, with certifications supporting work on sensitive government projects.

ThermOmegaTech Electronics differentiates itself through a modern process methodology, real-time communication, and a highly trained team. It holds AS9100D and CMMC Level 2 certifications alongside ISO 9001, ensuring secure, compliant manufacturing for regulated industries. The company emphasizes a one-point-of-contact model, collaborating in-house with its sister mechanical-engineering firm to deliver complete product development from concept to production.
